title: Date night
intro: Wine, a candlelit dinner, a show and a nightcap, all within a few blocks.

stops.note: Split a cheese board and two glasses before dinner.
Book ahead and ask for the window table.
Check the calendar for a show. Comedy nights are a good bet.
End with a cocktail, or a zero-proof one, near the river.

title: Kids' day
intro: Color, lunch, a run along the river and a toy store at the end.

stops.note: Cocoa and a croissant before the crowds.
Plan on two to three hours.
Everyone picks a different counter, then shares a table.
Watch the two rivers meet and let them run.
The play table in back is free.

title: Family in from out of town
intro: Show off the market, the history and the rivers, then feed everyone.

stops.note: On a market Saturday, start at the farmers' market. Other days, coffee on the square.
A quick way to see how Easton came to be.
Fast, filling and good for picky eaters.
Walk across to New Jersey and back for the view.
Booths for everyone, breakfast for dinner.

title: Rainy afternoon
intro: Short dashes between dry places with good things to look at.

stops.note: Lunch indoors.
Lose an hour in the stacks.
Try the listening stations.
Warm up with a pour-over.

title: Art walk
intro: Sculpture by the creek, a print studio and murals, then a drink.

stops.note: Walk the trail and look for the steel sculptures.
Local photography on the walls.
Thursday nights you can print your own.
Talk it over.

title: Night out with friends
intro: Pizza, a show and a late round.

stops.note: Order three pies for the table.
Catch whatever is on tonight.
Last call is at midnight.
